disease_label_per_paper: Paeniclostridium sordellii toxic shock syndrome after a septic abortion
presentation_summary: 19-year-old woman presented six days after medical termination of pregnancy with mifepristone and oral misoprostol.
She had heavy vaginal bleeding, cramping, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, generalized weakness, and loose stools over the prior day.
Initial vital signs showed fever 38.5 C, heart rate 92/min, respiratory rate 25/min, blood pressure 83/48 mmHg, and oxygen saturation 96% on room air.
Examination showed diaphoresis, diffuse abdominal tenderness with peritoneal signs, tan-brown blood in the vaginal vault, and diffuse pelvic tenderness.
Initial labs showed WBC 27,200/mcL, hemoglobin 13.7 g/dL, platelets 305,000/mcL, creatinine 1.1 mg/dL, BUN 20 mg/dL, lactate 1.7 mmol/L, INR 1.3, and PT 15 seconds.
Transvaginal ultrasound showed thickened hyperemic endometrium, open cervical os with echogenic material, and small pelvic ascites, raising concern for retained products of conception.
Emergent D&C removed a moderate amount of malodorous products of conception from an approximately 8-10 week uterus.
